analyst_view.overall: Early view: Mjallby are unbeaten in Europe (2-0 Inter Escaldes, 1-1 at Iberia, 2-0 Borac), the first Swedish side since Ostersund in 2017 to do that in the first three main-draw games. Pafos are on a six-game winless run and lost 3-1 at Twente after Lele's goal and later red card. A win would all but put Mjallby in the top 24.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals, already low. Nine of Mjallby's last 11 competitive games had fewer than three goals and they won 2-0 against Borac with a goal from a defensive error, so I agree with a low total.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners, mostly for Mjallby at home. Their best first-half chance against Borac came from a corner (an Axel Noren header), so set pieces matter for them, but nothing moves the estimate.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. Lele was sent off for a second booking for a cynical foul at Twente; that one-match ban should be served against Midtjylland on 26 November, so he is likely back here. The referee is not known, so I stay with the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. Mjallby did not dominate the first half against Borac and are patient rather than shot-heavy, but they have the home edge, so I stay with the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. I found nothing that moves it either way.
